notes.title: Upcoming Release ‘Precipice’ Now Available to Wishlist on Steam!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28039338/e8299cd86648c56d129450ef2287c8c96df91494.png[/img]

We’re excited to share with fans of Deep Sixed our next title [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/951670/Precipice/]Precipice[/url]; a tense turn-based strategy game of subterfuge for 1-2 players that’s set to launch in 2019 for Windows, Mac, and Linux platforms on Steam -- wishlist today to receive notification when the game releases later this year!

Precipice trailer: [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ri0Pc5xvJkM]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ri0Pc5xvJkM[/url]
Gameplay video: [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=f3cBQouCGbs]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=f3cBQouCGbs[/url]

We’re currently targeting late Winter / early Spring for release, and plan on putting together some testing opportunities to check out pre-release versions of Precipice. For those interested, we encourage you to sign-up for our newsletter on our website to receive announcements and updates on the game.

- The LRDGames Team

Join us on our Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/DE939dE]https://discord.gg/DE939dE[/url]
Follow us on Twitter: [url=https://twitter.com/LRDGames]@LRDGames[/url]

notes.title: Deep Sixed 1.10
notes.content:
Hi everybody,
we have been working hard to improve the game and fix all the glitches, typos, bugs and inconsistencies you have reported. Your feedback has been amazing and we're delighted that you enjoy Deep Sixed and that our game is getting so much love from players.

We've uploaded many updates over the last few days and we're now at version 1.10. Here are some of the most important fixes and changes since the release:
[list]
 [*]Some of the early "find and retrieve" and "find and kill" missions have been re-balanced to be less frustrating.

 [*]Some of the maintenance tasks have been rebalanced.

 [*]Permadeath is now disabled in Easy Mode. That means you can continue from the last save point when you die.

 [*]Many small glitches and a few serious bugs have been fixed.

 [*]Problems with the Mac version have been fixed.
[/list]
These days it's hard to get noticed among the dozens of games that are released on Steam every day - but the overwhelmingly positive feedback we're getting keeps us motivated.
If you enjoy Deeps Sixed, please consider leaving us a review on Steam and help us spread the word.
